nodes.label: Guideline
nodes.title: IKE-UW-124 Warehouse occupancy
nodes.excerpt:
# IKE-UW-124 Warehouse occupancy

Applies to finished-goods distribution, 3PL, and dry or refrigerated warehouse.

## Appetite

- Target: masonry or better, ESFR sprinklers, 30 ft or lower storage.
- Maximum without referral: **$40M** TIV per building.

## Referral / decline

- Referral: plastic commodities in racks above 25 ft, or tenant-controlled
  hazards unknown to the named insured.
- Decline: frame construction over $10M in a CAT zone.

## Linked applicants

* [Goya Foods Inc](../companies/goya-foods.md)
* [Texwin Acquisitions LLC](../companies/texwin-acquisitions.md)

# IKE-UW-322 Coastal named storm

## Rule

- Within **20 miles** of the Atlantic or Gulf coast: named-storm deductible
  **2%** of TIV, minimum $100,000.
- Wind sublimit unless construction is masonry non-combustible or better.
- Frame construction in this band is a decline over $10M.

nodes.label: Guideline
nodes.title: IKE-UW-240 Product contamination and recall
nodes.excerpt:
# IKE-UW-240 Product contamination and recall

## Appetite

- Accidental contamination and government-recall sublimits available to
  food occupancies that maintain a written recall plan and mock-recall log.
- Maximum recall sublimit without referral: **$5M**.

## Referral

- Brands with national distribution and no crisis-communications vendor.
- Prior FDA warning letter in the last 36 months.

## Linked applicants

* [Axium Foods Inc](../companies/axium-foods.md)
* [Goya Foods Inc](../companies/goya-foods.md)

nodes.title: IKE-UW-410 Thin named insured
nodes.excerpt:
# IKE-UW-410 Thin named insured

Applies when the applicant is an LLC or holdco formed in the last 24 months,
or when operating history sits in a recently acquired target.

## Rule

- Automatic referral.
- Require three years of target loss runs, not the LLC's blank history.
- Additional named insureds and mortgagees must be scheduled.
- Decline if no loss runs and TIV exceeds $25M.

## Linked applicants

* [Texwin Acquisitions LLC](../companies/texwin-acquisitions.md)

nodes.label: Guideline
nodes.title: IKE-UW-110 Food processing occupancy
nodes.excerpt:
# IKE-UW-110 Food processing occupancy

Applies to snack, frozen, canned, and packaged-food manufacturing.

## Appetite

- Target: sprinklered, FM-approved cooking protection, recall plan on file.
- Maximum without referral: **$30M** TIV at a single food-processing location.
- Combined food-processing schedule without referral: **$75M**.

## Referral / decline

- Referral: any location with deep-fat frying, ammonia refrigeration, or unsprinklered processing.
- Decline: uninsured product-recall exposure above $5M with no crisis vendor.

## Linked applicants

* [Axium Foods Inc](../companies/axium-foods.md)
* [Goya Foods Inc](../companies/goya-foods.md)

See also [IKE-UW-210 Cooking and fryer lines](hazard-cooking-fryer.md) and
[IKE-UW-240 Product contamination and recall](product-contamination-recall.md).

nodes.label: Guideline
nodes.title: IKE-UW-118 Life sciences occupancy
nodes.excerpt:
# IKE-UW-118 Life sciences occupancy

Applies to medical device, diagnostics, and biopharma manufacturing including
clean rooms and validated utilities.

## Appetite

- Target: sprinklered campuses, redundant utilities, documented BI worksheet.
- Maximum without referral: **$100M** TIV per campus.
- Business interruption: require 18-month period of indemnity for sterile fill
  or unique validated lines.

## Referral / decline

- Referral: single-source sterile capacity, or BI values above 40% of TIV.
- Decline: unvalidated contract-manufacturing with no COPE.

## Linked applicants

* [Baxter International](../companies/baxter-international.md)
